verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Al-hamdu Lillaahil-ladhee anzala alaa abdihil-kitaaba wa lam yaj'al lahu iwajaa
Qayyiman liyundhira ba'san shadeedan min ladunhu wa yubashshiral-mu'mineenal-ladheena ya'maloonas-saalihaati anna lahum ajran hasanaa
Maakitheena feehi abadaa
Wa yundhiral-ladheena qaalut-takhadha Allaahu waladaa
Maa lahum bihi min ilmin wa laa li-aabaa'ihim kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwaahihim in yaqooloona illaa kadhibaa
Fala'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka alaa aathaarihim in lam yu'minoo bihadhal-hadeethi asafaa
Innaa ja'alnaa maa alal-ardi zeenatan lahaa linabluwahum ayyuhum ahsanu amalaa
Wa innaa lajaa'iloona maa alayhaa sa'eedan juruzaa
Am hasibta anna ashaabal-kahfi war-raqeemi kaanoo min aayaatinaa ajabaa
Idh awal-fityatu ilal-kahfi faqaaloo rabbanaa aatinaa min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
Fadarabnaa alaa aadhaanihim fil-kahfi sineena adadaa
Thumma ba'athnaahum lina'lama ayyul-hizbayni ahsaa limaa labithoo amadaa
Nahnu naqussu alayka naba'ahum bil-haqqi innahum fityatun aamanoo birabbihim wa zidnaahum hudaa
Wa rabatnaa alaa quloobihim idh qaamoo faqaaloo rabbunaa rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi lan nad'uwa min doonihi ilahan laqad qulnaa idhan shatataa
Haa'ulaa'i qawmunaa ittakhadhoo min doonihi aalihatan lawlaa ya'toona alayhim bisultaanin bayyinin faman azlamu mimmani iftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhibaa
Wa idh i'tazaltumoohum wa maa ya'budoona illaa Allaaha fa'woo ilal-kahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum min rahmatihi wa yuhayyi lakum min amrikum mirfaqaa

Wa tarash-shamsa idhaa tala'at tazaawaru an kahfihim dhaatal-yameeni wa idhaa gharabat taqriduhum dhaatash-shimaali wa hum fee fajwatin minhu dhaalika min aayaati Allaahi man yahdi Allaahu fahuwal-muhtadi wa man yudlil falan tajida lahu waliyyan murshidaa

Wa tahsabuhum ayqaazan wa hum ruqoodun wa nuqallibuhum dhaatal-yameeni wa dhaatash-shimaali wa kalbuhum baasitun dhiraa'ayhi bil-waseedi lawit-tala'ta alayhim lawallayta minhum firaaran wa lamuli'ta minhum ru'baa

Wa kadhalika ba'athnaahum liyatasaa'aloo baynahum qaala qaa'ilun minhum kam labithtum qaaloo labithnaa yawman aw ba'da yawmin qaaloo rabbukum a'lamu bimaa labithtum faab'athoo ahadakum biwariqikum haadhihi ilal-madeenati falyanzur ayyuhaa azkaa ta'aaman falya'tikum birizqin minhu wa lyatalattaf wa laa yush'iranna bikum ahadaa
Innahum in yazharoo alaykum yarjumookum aw yu'eedookum fee millatihim wa lan tuflihoo idhan abadaa

Wa kadhalika a'tharnaa alayhim liya'lamoo anna wa'da Allaahi haqqun wa annas-saa'ata laa rayba feehaa idh yatanaaza'oona baynahum amrahum faqaaloo ubnoo alayhim bunyaanan rabbuhum a'lamu bihim qaalal-ladheena ghalaboo alaa amrihim lanattakhidhanna alayhim masjidaa

Sayaqooloona thalaathatun raabi'uhum kalbuhum wa yaqooloona khamsatun saadisuhum kalbuhum rajman bil-ghaybi wa yaqooloona sab'atun wa thaaminuhum kalbuhum qul rabbee a'lamu bi-iddatihim maa ya'lamuhum illaa qaleelun falaa tumaari feehim illaa miraa'an zaahiran wa laa tastafti feehim minhum ahadaa
Wa laa taqoolanna lishay'in innee fa-ilun dhaalika ghadaa
Illaa an yashaa'a Allaahu wadhkur rabbaka idhaa naseeta wa qul asaa an yahdiyani rabbee li'qraba min haadhaa rashadaa
Wa labithoo fee kahfihim thalaatha miaa'atin sineena wazdaadoo tis'aa
Quli Allaahu a'lamu bimaa labithoo lahu ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ardi absir bihi wa asmi maa lahum min doonihi min waliyyin wa laa yushriku fee hukmihi ahadaa
Watlu maa oohiya ilayka min kitaabi rabbika laa mubaddila likalimaatihi wa lan tajida min doonihi multahadaa

Wasbir nafsaka ma'al-ladheena yad'oona rabbahum bil-ghadaati wal-ashiyyi yureedoona wajhahu wa laa ta'du aynaaka anhum tureedu zeenatal-hayaatid-dunyaa wa laa tuti man aghfalnaa qalbahu an dhikrinaa wattaba'a hawaahu wa kaana amruhu furutaa

Wa qulil-haqqu min rabbikum faman shaa'a falyu'min wa man shaa'a falyakfur innaa a'tadnaa liz-zaalimeena naaran ahaata bihim suraadiquhaa wa in yastagheethoo yughaathoo bimaa'in kal-muhli yashwil-wujooha bi'sash-sharaabu wa saa'at murtafaqaa
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati innaa laa nudee'u ajra man ahsana amalaa

Ulaa'ika lahum jannaatu adnin tajree min tahtihimul-anhaaru yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min dhahabin wa yalbasoona thiyaaban khudran min sundusin wa istabraqin muttaki'eena feehaa alal-araa'iki ni'math-thawaabu wa hasunat murtafaqaa
Wadrib lahum mathalan rajulayni ja'alnaa li'hadihimaa jannatayni min a'naabin wa hafafnaahumaa binakhlin wa ja'alnaa baynahumaa zar'aa
Kiltal-jannatayni aatat ukulahaa wa lam tazlim minhu shay'an wa fajjarnaa khilaalahumaa naharaa
Wa kaana lahu thamarun faqaala lisaahibihi wa huwa yuhaawiruhu anaa aktharu minka maalan wa a'azzu nafaraa
Wa dakhala jannatahu wa huwa zaalimun linafsihi qaala maa azunnu an tabeeda haadhihi abadaa
Wa maa azunnus-saa'ata qaa'imatan wa la-in rudidtu ilaa rabbee la-ajidanna khayran minhaa munqalabaa
Qaala lahu saahibuhu wa huwa yuhaawiruhu akafarta billadhee khalaqaka min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma sawwaaka rajulaa
Laakinnaa huwallaahu rabbee wa laa ushriku birabbee ahadaa
Wa lawlaa idh dakhalta jannataka qulta maa shaa'a Allaahu laa quwwata illaa Billaahi in tarani anaa aqalla minka maalan wa waladaa
Fa-asaa rabbee an yu'tiyanee khayran min jannatika wa yursila alayhaa husbaanan minas-samaa'i fatusbiha sa'eedan zalaqaa
Aw yusbiha maa'uuhaa ghawran falan tastatee'a lahu talabaa
Wa uheeta bithamarihi fa-asbaha yuqallibu kaffayhi alaa maa anfaqa feehaa wa hiya khaawiyatun alaa urooshihaa wa yaqoolu yaa laytanee lam ushrik birabbee ahadaa
Wa lam takun lahu fi'atun yansuroonahu min doonillaahi wa maa kaana muntasiraa
Hunaalikal-walaayatu Lillaahil-haqqi huwa khayrun thawaaban wa khayrun uqbaa
Wadrib lahum mathalal-hayaatid-dunyaa kamaa'in anzalnaahu minas-samaa'i fakhtalata bihi nabaatul-ardi fa-asbaha hasheeman tadhroohur-riyaahu wa kaana Allaahu alaa kulli shay'in muqtadiraa
Al-maalu wal-banoona zeenatul-hayaatid-dunyaa wal-baaqiyaatus-saalihaatu khayrun inda rabbika thawaaban wa khayrun amalaa
Wa yawma nusayyirul-jibaala wa taral-arda baarizatan wa hasharnaahum falam nughaadir minhum ahadaa
Wa uridoo alaa rabbika saffan laqad ji'tumoonaa kamaa khalaqnaakum awwala marratin bal za'amtum allan naj'ala lakum maw'idaa

Wa wudi'al-kitaabu fataral-mujrimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa feehi wa yaqooloona yaa waylatanaa maali haadhal-kitaabi laa yughaadiru sagheeratan wa laa kabeeratan illaa ahsaahaa wa wajadoo maa amiloo haadiran wa laa yazlimu rabbuka ahadaa

Wa idh qulnaa lilmalaa'ikati usjudoo li'dama fasajadoo illaa ibleesa kaana minal-jinni fafasaqa an amri rabbihi afatattakhidhoonahu wa dhurriyyatahu awliyaa'a min doonee wa hum lakum aduwwun bi'sa liz-zaalimeena badalaa
Maa ashhadtuhum khalqas-samaawaati wal-ardi wa laa khalqa anfusihim wa maa kuntu muttakhidhal-mudilleena adudaa
Wa yawma yaqoolu naadoo shurakaa'iyal-ladheena za'amtum fada'awhum falam yastajeeboo lahum wa ja'alnaa baynahum mawbiqaa
Wa ra'al-mujrimoonan-naara fazannoo annahum muwaaqi'oohaa wa lam yajidoo anhaa masrifaa
Wa laqad sarrafnaa fee haadhal-qur'aani lin-naasi min kulli mathalin wa kaanal-insaanu akthara shay'in jadalaa
Wa maa mana'an-naasa an yu'minoo idh jaa'ahumul-hudaa wa yastaghfiroo rabbahum illaa an ta'tiyahum sunnatul-awwaleena aw ya'tiyahumul-adhaabu qubulaa
Wa maa nursilul-mursaleena illaa mubashshireena wa mundhireena wa yujaadilul-ladheena kafaroo bil-baatili liyudhidoo bihil-haqqa wattakhadhoo aayaatee wa maa undhiroo huzuwaa

Wa man azlamu mimman dhukkira bi-aayaati rabbihi fa-a'rada anhaa wa nasiya maa qaddamat yadaahu innaa ja'alnaa alaa quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wa fee aadhaanihim waqran wa in tad'uhum ilal-hudaa falan yahtadoo idhan abadaa
Wa rabbukal-ghafooru dhur-rahmati law yu'uaakhidhuhum bimaa kasaboo la-ajjala lahumul-adhaaba bal lahum maw'idun lan yajidoo min doonihi maw'ilaa
Wa tilkal-quraa ahlaknaahum lammaa zalamoo wa ja'alnaa limahlikihim maw'idaa
Wa idh qaala moosaa lifataahu laa abrahu hattaa ablugha majma'al-bahrayni aw amdiya huqubaa
Falammaa balaghaa majma'a baynihimaa nasiyaa hootahumaa fattakhadha sabeelahu fil-bahri sarabaa
Falammaa jaawazaa qaala lifataahu aatinaa ghadaa'anaa laqad laqeenaa min safarinaa haadhaa nasabaa
Qaala ara'ayta idh awaynaa ilas-sakhrati fa-innee naseetul-hoota wa maa ansaaneehu illash-shaytaanu an adhkurahu wattakhadha sabeelahu fil-bahri ajabaa
Qaala dhaalika maa kunnaa nabghi fartaddaa alaa aathaarihimaa qasasaa
Fawajadaa abdan min ibaadinaa aataynaahu rahmatan min indinaa wa allamnaahu min ladunnaa ilmaa
Qaala lahu moosaa hal attabi'uka alaa an tu'allimani mimmaa ullimta rushdaa
Qaala innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa
Wa kayfa tasbiru alaa maa lam tuhit bihi khubraa
Qaala satajidunee in shaa'a Allaahu saabiran wa laa a'see laka amraa
Qaala fa-ini ittaba'tanee falaa tas'alnee an shay'in hattaa uhditha laka minhu dhikraa
Fantalaqaa hattaa idhaa rakibaa fis-safeenati kharaqahaa qaala akharaqtahaa litughriqa ahlahaa laqad ji'ta shay'an imraa
Qaala alam aqul innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa
Qaala laa tu'aakhidhnee bimaa naseetu wa laa turhiqnee min amree usraa
Fantalaqaa hattaa idhaa laqiyaa ghulaaman faqatalahu qaala aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatan bighayri nafsin laqad ji'ta shay'an nukraa
Qaala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa
Qaala in sa'altuka an shay'in ba'dahaa falaa tusaahibnee qad balaghta min ladunnee udhraa
Fantalaqaa hattaa idhaa atayaa ahla qaryatin istat'amaa ahlahaa fa-abaw an yudayyifoohumaa fawajadaa feehaa jidaaran yureedu an yanqadda fa-aqaamahu qaala law shi'ta laattakhadhta alayhi ajraa
Qaala haadhaa firaaqu baynee wa baynika sa'unabbi'uka bita'weeli maa lam tastati alayhi sabraa
Ammas-safeenatu fakaanat limasaakeena ya'maloona fil-bahri fa-aradtu an a'eebahaa wa kaana waraa'ahum malikun ya'khudhu kulla safeenatin ghasbaa
Wa ammal-ghulaamu fakaana abawaahu mu'minayni fakhasheenaa an yurhiqahumaa tughyaanan wa kufraa
Fa-aradnaa an yubdilahumaa rabbuhumaa khayran minhu zakaatan wa aqraba ruhmaa

Wa ammal-jidaaru fakaana lighulaamayni yateemayni fil-madeenati wa kaana tahtahu kanzun lahumaa wa kaana aboohumaa saalihan fa-araada rabbuka an yablughaa ashuddahumaa wa yastakhrijaa kanzahumaa rahmatan min rabbika wa maa fa-altuhu an amree dhaalika ta'weelu maa lam tasti alayhi sabraa
Wa yas'aloonaka an dhil-qarnayni qul sa'atloo alaykum minhu dhikraa
Innaa makkannaa lahu fil-ardi wa aataynaahu min kulli shay'in sababaa
Fa-atba'a sababaa
Hattaa idhaa balagha maghribash-shamsi wajadahaa taghrubu fee aynin hami'atin wa wajada indahaa qawman qulnaa yaa dhal-qarnayni immaa an tu'adhdhiba wa immaa an tattakhidha feehim husnaa
Qaala ammaa man zalama fasawfa nu'adhdhibuhu thumma yuraddu ilaa rabbihi fayu'adhdhibuhu adhaaban nukraa
Wa ammaa man aamana wa amila saalihan falahu jazaa'an al-husnaa wa sanaqoolu lahu min amrinaa yusraa
Thumma atba'a sababaa
Hattaa idhaa balagha matli'ash-shamsi wajadahaa tatlu'u alaa qawmin lam naj'al lahum min doonihaa sitraa
Kadhaalika wa qad ahatnaa bimaa ladayhi khubraa
Thumma atba'a sababaa
Hattaa idhaa balagha baynas-saddayni wajada min doonihimaa qawman laa yakaadoona yafqahoona qawlaa
Qaaloo yaa dhal-qarnayni inna ya'jooja wa ma'jooja mufsidoona fil-ardi fahal naj'alu laka kharjan alaa an taj'ala baynanaa wa baynahum saddaa
Qaala maa makkananee feehi rabbee khayrun fa-a'eenoonee biquwwatin aj'al baynakum wa baynahum radmaa
Aatoonee zubaral-hadeedi hattaa idhaa saawaa baynas-sadafayni qaalan-fukhoo hattaa idhaa ja'alahu naaran qaala aatoonee ufrigh alayhi qitraa
Famas-taa'oo an yazharoohu wa mas-tataa'oo lahu naqbaa
Qaala haadhaa rahmatun min rabbee fa-idhaa jaa'a wa'du rabbee ja'alahu dakkaa'a wa kaana wa'du rabbee haqqaa
Wa taraknaa ba'dahum yawma'idhin yamooju fee ba'din wa nufikha fis-soori fajama'naahum jam'aa
Wa aradnaa jahannama yawma'idhin lilkaafireena ardaa
Al-ladheena kaanat a'yunuhum fee ghitaa'in an dhikree wa kaanoo laa yastatee'oona sam'aa
Afahasibal-ladheena kafaroo an yattakhidhoo ibaadee min doonee awliyaa'a innaa a'tadnaa jahannama lilkaafireena nuzulaa
Qul hal nunabbi'ukum bil-akhsareena a'maalaa
Al-ladheena dalla sa'yuhum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa hum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona sun'aa
Oola'ikal-ladheena kafaroo bi-aayaati rabbihim wa liqaa'ihi fahabitat a'maaluhum falaa nuqeemu lahum yawmal-qiyaamati waznaa
Dhaalika jazaa'uuhum jahannamu bimaa kafaroo wattakhadhoo aayaatee wa rusulee huzuwaa
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati kaanat lahum jannaatul-firdawsi nuzulaa
Khaalideena feehaa laa yabghoona anhaa hiwalaa
Qul law kaanal-bahru midaadan likalimaati rabbee lanafidal-bahru qabla an tanfada kalimaatu rabbee wa law ji'naa bimithlihi madadaa
Qul innamaa anaa basharun mithlukum yoohaa ilayya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahun waahidun faman kaana yarjoo liqaa'a rabbihi falya'mal amalan saalihan wa laa yushrik bi-ibaadati rabbihi ahadaa
